label: Unrestricted free absence among distinct concrete candidates at w
paraphrase: Recombination, absence half of Hume's dictum, unrestricted, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for any two distinct concrete candidates x and y, if x exists at some world accessible from w, then x exists without y at some world accessible from w. Pairwise only: it realizes no combination of more than two candidates at once. Applies to every concrete candidate, whatever its modal status.
